What this establishes

Spatial geometry can distinguish a square edge from a rounded or flat surface before the axle reaches it. This probe measures circle clearance only. It does not predict forces, tyre shape, rim or spoke stress, tubeless leakage, soil deformation or grip.

Rounded fixtures use 32 straight segments. Sharp edges have no inferred rounding radius. A full impact model must enforce suspension travel and supported component failure, and later handle layered mud/roots, rolling traction and 3D lateral/turning loads. Detailed contact and separate update rates still require convergence and real-time measurements.
